front.title: Common Format and Media Type for Control-Character-Separated Values (CCSV) Files

abstract.t: This document specifies the Control-Character-Separated Values (CCSV) file format, a UTF-8 encoded tabular data format that uses ASCII control characters as field and record separators. CCSV is intended for exchanging structured, rectangular data between applications such as databases, spreadsheets, statistical software, and data conversion utilities. This document also specifies the text/csv media type for CCSV files.
